requirements.original: bit2oct(in bitstring invalue) return octetstring
requirements.canonical: The predefined function `bit2oct` has the signature `bit2oct(in bitstring invalue) return octetstring`.
requirements.header: // @requirement: C.1.15 -- bit2oct(in bitstring invalue) return octetstring

requirements.original: This function converts a single bitstring value to a single octetstring.
requirements.canonical: The predefined function `bit2oct` converts a single bitstring value into a single octetstring value.
requirements.header: // @requirement: C.1.15 -- This function converts a single bitstring value to a single octetstring.

requirements.original: The resulting octetstring represents the same value as the bitstring.
requirements.canonical: The octetstring returned by `bit2oct` represents the same value as the bitstring `invalue`.
requirements.header: // @requirement: C.1.15 -- The resulting octetstring represents the same value as the bitstring.

requirements.original: For the conversion the following holds: bit2oct(value)=hex2oct(bit2hex(value)).
requirements.canonical: For every bitstring value `v`, `bit2oct(v)` IS equal to `hex2oct(bit2hex(v))`.
requirements.header: // @requirement: C.1.15 -- For the conversion the following holds: bit2oct(value)=hex2oct(bit2hex(value)).

requirements.original: The general error causes in clause 16.1.2 apply.
requirements.canonical: The general error causes of clause 16.1.2 SHALL apply to `bit2oct`.
requirements.header: // @requirement: C.1.15 -- The general error causes in clause 16.1.2 apply.

requirements.original: bit2str(in bitstring invalue) return charstring
requirements.canonical: The predefined function `bit2str` has the signature `bit2str(in bitstring invalue) return charstring`.
requirements.header: // @requirement: C.1.16 -- bit2str(in bitstring invalue) return charstring

requirements.original: This function converts a single bitstring value to a single charstring.
requirements.canonical: The predefined function `bit2str` converts a single bitstring value into a single charstring value.
requirements.header: // @requirement: C.1.16 -- This function converts a single bitstring value to a single charstring.

requirements.original: The resulting charstring has the same length as the bitstring and contains only the characters '0' and '1'.
requirements.canonical: The charstring returned by `bit2str` has the same length as the bitstring `invalue`.
requirements.header: // @requirement: C.1.16 -- The resulting charstring has the same length as the bitstring and contains only the characters '0' and '1'.

requirements.original: The resulting charstring has the same length as the bitstring and contains only the characters '0' and '1'.
requirements.canonical: The charstring returned by `bit2str` contains only the characters "0" and "1".
requirements.header: // @requirement: C.1.16 -- The resulting charstring has the same length as the bitstring and contains only the characters '0' and '1'.

requirements.original: Each bit of the bitstring is converted into a character '0' or '1' depending on the value 0 or 1 of the bit.
requirements.canonical: `bit2str` SHALL convert each bit of the bitstring into the character "0" or "1" according to the value 0 or 1 of the bit.
requirements.header: // @requirement: C.1.16 -- Each bit of the bitstring is converted into a character '0' or '1' depending on the value 0 or 1 of the bit.

requirements.original: The consecutive order of characters in the resulting charstring is the same as the order of bits in the bitstring.
requirements.canonical: The order of characters in the charstring returned by `bit2str` IS the same as the order of bits in the bitstring.
requirements.header: // @requirement: C.1.16 -- The consecutive order of characters in the resulting charstring is the same as the order of bits in the bitstring.

requirements.original: The general error causes in clause 16.1.2 apply.
requirements.canonical: The general error causes of clause 16.1.2 SHALL apply to `bit2str`.
requirements.header: // @requirement: C.1.16 -- The general error causes in clause 16.1.2 apply.

requirements.original: hex2int(in hexstring invalue) return integer
requirements.canonical: The predefined function `hex2int` has the signature `hex2int(in hexstring invalue) return integer`.
requirements.header: // @requirement: C.1.17 -- hex2int(in hexstring invalue) return integer

requirements.original: This function converts a single hexstring value to a single integer value.
requirements.canonical: The predefined function `hex2int` converts a single hexstring value to a single integer value.
requirements.header: // @requirement: C.1.17 -- This function converts a single hexstring value to a single integer value.

requirements.original: For the purposes of this conversion, a hexstring shall be interpreted as a positive base 16 integer value.
requirements.canonical: For the conversion by `hex2int`, the hexstring value SHALL be interpreted as a positive base 16 integer value.
requirements.header: // @requirement: C.1.17 -- For the purposes of this conversion, a hexstring shall be interpreted as a positive base 16 integer value.

requirements.original: The rightmost hexadecimal digit is least significant, the leftmost hexadecimal digit is the most significant.
requirements.canonical: In the conversion by `hex2int`, the rightmost hexadecimal digit IS the least significant digit.
requirements.header: // @requirement: C.1.17 -- The rightmost hexadecimal digit is least significant, the leftmost hexadecimal digit is the most significant.

requirements.original: The rightmost hexadecimal digit is least significant, the leftmost hexadecimal digit is the most significant.
requirements.canonical: In the conversion by `hex2int`, the leftmost hexadecimal digit IS the most significant digit.
requirements.header: // @requirement: C.1.17 -- The rightmost hexadecimal digit is least significant, the leftmost hexadecimal digit is the most significant.

requirements.original: The hexadecimal digits 0 to F represent the decimal values 0 to 15 respectively.
requirements.canonical: In the conversion by `hex2int`, the hexadecimal digits 0 to F represent the decimal values 0 to 15 respectively.
requirements.header: // @requirement: C.1.17 -- The hexadecimal digits 0 to F represent the decimal values 0 to 15 respectively.

requirements.original: The general error causes in clause 16.1.2 apply.
requirements.canonical: The general error causes defined in clause 16.1.2 SHALL apply to `hex2int`.
requirements.header: // @requirement: C.1.17 -- The general error causes in clause 16.1.2 apply.

requirements.original: hex2bit(in hexstring invalue) return bitstring
requirements.canonical: The predefined function `hex2bit` has the signature `hex2bit(in hexstring invalue) return bitstring`.
requirements.header: // @requirement: C.1.18 -- hex2bit(in hexstring invalue) return bitstring

requirements.original: This function converts a single hexstring value to a single bitstring.
requirements.canonical: The predefined function `hex2bit` converts a single hexstring value to a single bitstring value.
requirements.header: // @requirement: C.1.18 -- This function converts a single hexstring value to a single bitstring.

requirements.original: The resulting bitstring represents the same value as the hexstring.
requirements.canonical: The bitstring value returned by `hex2bit` represents the same value as the input hexstring value.
requirements.header: // @requirement: C.1.18 -- The resulting bitstring represents the same value as the hexstring.

requirements.original: For the purpose of this conversion, a hexstring shall be converted into a bitstring, where the hex digits of the hexstring are converted in groups of bits as follows:
requirements.canonical: The predefined function `hex2bit` SHALL convert each hex digit of the hexstring value into a group of 4 bits according to the mapping '0'H to '0000'B through 'F'H to '1111'B.
requirements.header: // @requirement: C.1.18 -- For the purpose of this conversion, a hexstring shall be converted into a bitstring, where the hex digits of the hexstring are converted in groups of bits as follows:

requirements.canonical: The predefined function `hex2bit` converts the hex digits '0'H, '1'H, '2'H, '3'H, '4'H and '5'H into '0000'B, '0001'B, '0010'B, '0011'B, '0100'B and '0101'B respectively.
The predefined function `hex2bit` converts the hex digits '6'H, '7'H, '8'H, '9'H, 'A'H and 'B'H into '0110'B, '0111'B, '1000'B, '1001'B, '1010'B and '1011'B respectively.
The predefined function `hex2bit` converts the hex digits 'C'H, 'D'H, 'E'H and 'F'H into '1100'B, '1101'B, '1110'B and '1111'B respectively.

requirements.original: The consecutive order of the groups of 4 bits in the resulting bitstring is the same as the order of hex digits in the hexstring.
requirements.canonical: The order of the groups of 4 bits in the bitstring value returned by `hex2bit` IS the same as the order of the hex digits in the input hexstring value.
requirements.header: // @requirement: C.1.18 -- The consecutive order of the groups of 4 bits in the resulting bitstring is the same as the order of hex digits in the hexstring.

requirements.original: The general error causes in clause 16.1.2 apply.
requirements.canonical: The general error causes defined in clause 16.1.2 SHALL apply to `hex2bit`.
requirements.header: // @requirement: C.1.18 -- The general error causes in clause 16.1.2 apply.

requirements.original: hex2oct(in hexstring invalue) return octetstring
requirements.canonical: The predefined function `hex2oct` has the signature `hex2oct(in hexstring invalue) return octetstring`.
requirements.header: // @requirement: C.1.19 -- hex2oct(in hexstring invalue) return octetstring

requirements.original: This function converts a single hexstring value to a single octetstring.
requirements.canonical: The predefined function `hex2oct` converts a single hexstring value to a single octetstring value.
requirements.header: // @requirement: C.1.19 -- This function converts a single hexstring value to a single octetstring.

requirements.original: The resulting octetstring represents the same value as the hexstring.
requirements.canonical: The octetstring value returned by `hex2oct` represents the same value as the input hexstring value.
requirements.header: // @requirement: C.1.19 -- The resulting octetstring represents the same value as the hexstring.

requirements.original: For the purpose of this conversion, a hexstring shall be converted into a octetstring, where the octetstring contains the same sequence of hex digits as the hexstring when the length of the hexstring modulo 2 is 0.
requirements.canonical: If the length of the input hexstring value modulo 2 is 0, the octetstring value returned by `hex2oct` SHALL contain the same sequence of hex digits as the hexstring value.
requirements.condition: the length of the hexstring modulo 2 is 0

ambiguity.issue: Uses 'a octetstring' and 'hex digits' of an octetstring; the octetstring is meant as its sequence of hexadecimal digits (nibbles).

requirements.header: // @requirement: C.1.19 -- For the purpose of this conversion, a hexstring shall be converted into a octetstring, where the octetstring contains the same sequence of hex digits as the hexstring when the length of the hexstring modulo 2 is 0.

requirements.original: Otherwise, the resulting octetstring contains 0 as leftmost hex digit followed by the same sequence of hex digits as in the hexstring.
requirements.canonical: If the length of the input hexstring value is odd, the octetstring value returned by `hex2oct` SHALL contain the hex digit 0 as leftmost hex digit followed by the same sequence of hex digits as in the hexstring value.
requirements.condition: the length of the hexstring modulo 2 is not 0
requirements.header: // @requirement: C.1.19 -- Otherwise, the resulting octetstring contains 0 as leftmost hex digit followed by the same sequence of hex digits as in the hexstring.

requirements.original: The general error causes in clause 16.1.2 apply.
requirements.canonical: The general error causes defined in clause 16.1.2 SHALL apply to `hex2oct`.
requirements.header: // @requirement: C.1.19 -- The general error causes in clause 16.1.2 apply.

requirements.canonical: The predefined function `hex2str` has the signature `hex2str(in hexstring invalue) return charstring`.
requirements.header: // @requirement: C.1.20 -- hex2str(in hexstring invalue) return charstring

requirements.original: This function converts a single hexstring value to a single charstring.
requirements.canonical: The predefined function `hex2str` converts a single hexstring value to a single charstring value.
requirements.header: // @requirement: C.1.20 -- This function converts a single hexstring value to a single charstring.

requirements.original: The resulting charstring has the same length as the hexstring and contains only the characters '0' to '9'and 'A' to 'F'.
requirements.canonical: The charstring value returned by `hex2str` has the same length as the input hexstring value.
requirements.header: // @requirement: C.1.20 -- The resulting charstring has the same length as the hexstring and contains only the characters '0' to '9'and 'A' to 'F'.

requirements.original: The resulting charstring has the same length as the hexstring and contains only the characters '0' to '9'and 'A' to 'F'.
requirements.canonical: The charstring value returned by `hex2str` contains only the characters '0' to '9' and 'A' to 'F'.
requirements.header: // @requirement: C.1.20 -- The resulting charstring has the same length as the hexstring and contains only the characters '0' to '9'and 'A' to 'F'.

requirements.original: For the purpose of this conversion, a hexstring shall be converted into a charstring.
requirements.canonical: The predefined function `hex2str` SHALL convert the hexstring value into a charstring value.
requirements.header: // @requirement: C.1.20 -- For the purpose of this conversion, a hexstring shall be converted into a charstring.

requirements.original: Each hex digit of the hexstring is converted into a character '0' to '9' and 'A' to 'F' depending on the value 0 to 9 or A to F of the hex digit.
requirements.canonical: The predefined function `hex2str` converts each hex digit of the hexstring value into the character '0' to '9' or 'A' to 'F' corresponding to the value 0 to 9 or A to F of the hex digit.
requirements.header: // @requirement: C.1.20 -- Each hex digit of the hexstring is converted into a character '0' to '9' and 'A' to 'F' depending on the value 0 to 9 or A to F of the hex digit.

requirements.original: The consecutive order of characters in the resulting charstring is the same as the order of digits in the hexstring.
requirements.canonical: The order of the characters in the charstring value returned by `hex2str` IS the same as the order of the hex digits in the input hexstring value.
requirements.header: // @requirement: C.1.20 -- The consecutive order of characters in the resulting charstring is the same as the order of digits in the hexstring.

requirements.original: The general error causes in clause 16.1.2 apply.
requirements.canonical: The general error causes defined in clause 16.1.2 SHALL apply to `hex2str`.
requirements.header: // @requirement: C.1.20 -- The general error causes in clause 16.1.2 apply.
